:::{#exm-borel-sigma-algebra-half-lines}
#### The Borel $\sigma$-algebra contains $\reals$ and the half-lines

The [interval](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-interval) $(-\infty, 0)$ is in $\borel$ by @def-borel-sigma-algebra.
So is its [complement](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-complement) $[0, \infty)$,
because $\borel$ is a $\sigma$-algebra (@def-sigma-algebra).
The [set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-set) $\reals$ is in $\borel$ too:
a $\sigma$-algebra on $\reals$ contains $\reals$ itself.

:::
